list.name: Rex
list.ins: Rex, from before the landing to year 1 day 69, died of thirst. First hunter; First herder.

list.name: Bal
list.ins: Bal, from before the landing to year 1 day 100, died of starvation. Bal rediscovered animal keeping. They worked it out with their own hands.

list.name: Zean
list.ins: Zean, from before the landing to year 1 day 100, died of starvation. First in hide working.

list.name: Ket
list.ins: Ket, from before the landing to year 1 day 100, died of starvation. Chob and Bral and 2 others mourn Zean.

list.name: Lair
list.ins: Lair, from before the landing to year 2 day 1, died of old age. First farmer.

list.name: Chool
list.ins: Chool, from year 1 day 43 to year 2 day 4, died of cold. Chool mourns Ket.

entries.text: Rex made the first leaf bed.
Zean worked a hide until it stayed soft. They watched it happen.
The Hide age begins.
Rex brought down the first hopper: fresh meat.
The village can now raise a hide teepee (hide stretched on poles): the design is in the Blueprints panel.
Lair saw a seed come up where food had rotted, and understood. They watched it happen.
Rex saw that a hopper will stay where it is fed, and understood. They worked it out with their own hands.
Food is running short: about 1.9 days left in the stockpile.
Chob built the first drying rack.
Bral was born to Chob and Zean.
The old thornback died in its cave.
A new thornback has moved into the cave.
Chool was born to Bal and Ket.
Cheak was born to Ne and Rex.
Lightning struck a tree 13 cells from the camp. It is burning.
Chob was first to keep a fire. They watched it happen.
The Hearth age dawns, behind the Hide age.
Chob built the first fire ring.
Chob lit the first hearth fire.
Chob was first to burn wood to black coal. They watched it happen.
The burning tree has fallen in on itself and smoulders.
The old thornback died in its cave.
A new thornback has moved into the cave.
Rex (generation 1) died of thirst, aged 3.4 years - 8 beds for 10.
Ne and Cheak and 1 other mourn Rex.
The last person who knew animal keeping has died: Rex. It will have to be found again.
Bal rediscovered animal keeping. They worked it out with their own hands.
Di was born to Chob and Zean.
The old thornback died in its cave.
A new thornback has moved into the cave.
Bal (generation 1) died of starvation, aged 2.5 years - the stockpile held 0.0 days of food per head.
Ket and Chool and 1 other mourn Bal.
The last person who knew animal keeping has died: Bal. It will have to be found again.
Zean (generation 1) died of starvation, aged 2.2 years - the stockpile held 0.0 days of food per head.
Chob and Bral and 2 others mourn Zean.
The last person who knew hide working has died: Zean. It will have to be found again.
The village has slipped back from the Hide age to the Hearth age.
Ket (generation 1) died of starvation, aged 2.4 years - the stockpile held 0.0 days of food per head.
Chool mourns Ket.
The first winter is over: 7 survive.
A whole winter passed and nobody died of cold.
Lair (generation 1) died of old age, aged 3.5 years.
The last person who knew farming has died: Lair. It will have to be found again.
Chool (generation 2) died of cold, aged 0.6 years - was caught out in the cold; 8 beds for 6.
